neighbours.label: Dense unit (53% of tokens reach 0.1 of max, gate-closed leak regime). Best guess at what lifts it highest: the word piece right after a split-off 'in' prefix ('in|appropri|ately', 'in|consider|ate', 'in|lay').
fire: The manager admitted the joke had been inappropriate for a staff meeting.
Several viewers complained that the advert was inappropriately cheerful.
Leaving the dishes for her again seemed inconsiderate to everyone.

The jewellery box was finished with a mother-of-pearl inlay.

notes: Card flags dense and gate-closed; top pieces 'appropri' x6, 'consider', 'lay' after 'in'. Probe: those 0.83-0.93, but an ordinary sentence still reads 0.31 and 'baskets' 0.45, so near misses are expected to cross 0.30. Recorded to document the density.
